game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Snowy Hold – Wolf Watch, a lookout against wolves: the snow ranger must handle icicle bats while practicing functions. Core idea – Helper Factory: Refactor repeated code into helper functions to save time during a rush.
theme: Snowy Hold – Wolf Watch: a lookout against wolves
core_gameplay_loop: In Wolf Watch, repeat each round: Refactor repeated code into helper functions to save time during a rush. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the refactor_score value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the watch bell using at most 21 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: The watch bell reached with actions_used <= 21.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 21 before the watch bell is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 7 (applied tier): Helper Factory
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Helper Factory' (Week 6 slot 6), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Wolf Watch'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Snowy Hold
region.mood: soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how refactor_score changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against icicle bats in Wolf Watch.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The watch bell reached with actions_used <= 21.
